### Added

- (agent-platform) [Classify failed sessions and add the notification row rule](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3035) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Groundwork for the notification bell below: the portal now tells why a failed session failed (model unavailable, a tool failed, runtime lost or other) without passing on the failure's text, and decides which sessions get a notification.
- (agent-platform) [Set a session's notification level from its menu](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3038) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A session's ⋯ menu, on its page and in the Sessions list, has a `Notifications` submenu with `Default`, `All activity` and `Muted`. The notification bell follows it: All activity adds finished turns, Muted leaves the session out.
- (agent-platform, muster) [Name the installation on every connector, tool and workflow link](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3032) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The command palette lists a connector once per environment it is registered on, each opening the connector in that environment, instead of one row for all of them.
- (agent-platform, muster) [Move the Agent Platform to URLs that follow the rail](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3061) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Agent Platform pages move to shorter addresses: `/sessions`, `/usage`, `/profile`, and every agent, skill, connector, model and workflow page under its Customize tab. Old links and bookmarks land on the same page. For operators: `app.extensions` entries naming `page:agent-platform/skills`, `sub-page:agent-platform/sessions`, `sub-page:agent-platform/usage` or `page:muster/mcp-servers-redirect` no longer apply.
- (app, agent-platform, ui-react) [Add the Notification inbox to the Agent Platform shell](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3040) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A bell on the rail's Profile row counts and lists the sessions waiting for you, failed, or finished a turn (at `All activity`), with `Mark all read` and a `Desktop notifications` switch. The tab title shows the unread count; on a phone the list is in the Profile menu.
- (muster) [Keep the typed connector name as its display name](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3072) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A connector added under Customize's Connectors keeps the name you typed, e.g. `Stack Overflow`, as the name shown everywhere, and Edit can rename it; its technical name stays. Needs muster 5.43.0 or later; an older muster registers connectors as before.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Show a failed agent read as an error with Retry, not as no agents](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3059) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — When reading your agents fails, or an outdated cached list is restored, the Agent Platform home no longer offers to create a first agent: it shows `Couldn't load your agents` with `Retry`, and `No agents yet` only after a read that found none.
- (agent-platform) [Show an error when an answer cannot resume the session](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3044) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Answering an agent's question in a session kagent can no longer resume shows `Could not resume this session` instead of silently doing nothing, and offers a new session that starts with the conversation so far and your answer.
- (agent-platform) [Carry the whole conversation into a lost runtime's new session](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3070) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — When a session's runtime is lost, its notice has a `Continue in a new session` button that starts a new session with the whole conversation and a `Continued session` banner linking back. A session that cannot continue no longer shows a message box.
- (muster) [Make the Reads and Changes things badges legible](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3071) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On a connector's tool list, tool and workflow pages, the agent tool catalogue and the approval card, the `Reads` and `Changes things` labels are 12px instead of 10px, and `Reads` has a light grey background instead of showing as bare text.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.7.1...v3.8.0
